name: @waterbots/wellington
description: WaterBots open core module: wellington (the Team Lead). His instructions, the project types, the checks on what he heard, and his reading of the agent map. Not published.

scripts.build:text: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const t={};for(const [k,f] of [['PROMPT_MD','prompt'],['PRIMER_MD','primer'],['FREE_SITE_MD','free-site'],['PAID_SITE_MD','paid-site'],['LOBBY_CHAT_MD','lobby-chat']])t[k]=fs.readFileSync('src/agents/wellington/'+f+'.md','utf8').split(String.fromCharCode(13)).join('');fs.writeFileSync('src/ownText.generated.ts',['// MADE BY npm run build:text FROM src/agents/wellington/*.md. Change those files, then run it.',...Object.entries(t).map(([k,v])=>'export const '+k+': string = '+JSON.stringify(v)+';'),''].join(String.fromCharCode(10)))"
